answer_2.quote: We report the recall of reasoning gaps for which Φ found a match among the five fallacy predictions (R@5). As a primary measure we report recall, precision P@1 and Arg@1. These metrics are computed automatically via the Φ_f and Φ_f+p matching functions.

answer_3.quote: ϕ_f+p uses a Llama3-8B model, fine‑tuned with QLoRA adapters on the human evaluation data from MISSCI. The model is applied after generation to decide whether a generated fallacy matches the gold fallacy.
